dedupe_keys.name: web experience in mobile networks lessons from two million page visits

description: A MONROE study deposits measurements from nearly two million mobile web-browsing sessions over eleven commercial networks in four countries. Zenodo lists several public CSV files and small analysis scripts under CC BY 4.0. The own page says the study compared web protocols, browsers, radio technologies and mobility conditions, and observed performance penalties around handover. These session-level data could calibrate telecom-service latency or application quality models used in digital-infrastructure simulations. They are historical controlled measurements, not present-day performance guarantees for the same operators. The public description does not identify every country, CSV column or sampling interval, and several files are overlapping analysis subsets, not independent campaigns. The scripts are study-analysis aids, not a separate general simulator. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this mobile-web package. The CSV files and scripts were not downloaded or executed, so session counts and reported effects remain provider statements.
name: Web Experience in Mobile Networks: Lessons from Two Million Page Visits
